newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay to issue $250-$270 million in Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay to issue $250-$270 million in Eurobonds.

text.p: Uruguay will issue $250-$270 million in Eurobonds on June 30 in the country's largest ever debt sale, a senior central bank official confirmed Thursday.
"The launch will be in New York and the amount will range between $250 and $270 million," the official told Reuters. "The figure is not yet decided."
ING Barings chief economist Arturo Porzecanski, the lead manager of the deal, said in Lima Wednesday that Uruguay would issue about $300 million in 30-year Eurobonds.

The issue, unprecedented in size, "is very significant," the central bank official said. "To begin with it changes the indebtedness profile of the country and also confirms the solidity of the state."
Early this year Duff & Phelps gave Uruguayan debt an investment grade rating.
The government does not foresee additional issues of this kind this year, the central bank source said.
